Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class FaceSearchFrame

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.FaceSearchFrame
public final class FaceSearchFrame extends java.lang.Object
Complete search sample. Coordinates are rotated, unmirrored image pixels. frameId identifies the frame, not a tracked face.

  • Method Details

    • getFrameId

      public long getFrameId()
      Associates detection, scores, and final results from the same frame. Do not use it to establish identity across frames.

    • getInfrared

      @Nullable public InfraredSearchInfo getInfrared()
      Original RGB search returns null. IR mode includes only the status from the same sample; it does not reuse a liveness pass from another frame.
